jobs.title: Chief Security Architect
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Chief Security Architect is a part-time, hybrid role based in Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates, with flexibility for some work from home. This role is responsible for defining and maintaining the overall security architecture, including policies, standards, and reference designs across infrastructure, applications, and networks. Daily activities include assessing current and planned systems for security risks, designing secure solutions, reviewing architecture and code for vulnerabilities, and guiding remediation efforts. The Chief Security Architect collaborates with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to align security architecture with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. The role also involves leading threat modeling, advising on incident response readiness, mentoring technical teams on secure design principles, and evaluating security tools and technologies.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong skills in Security Architecture Design, including developing enterprise security frameworks, reference architectures, and standards.
Candidates should possess skills in Application Security, such as secure SDLC practices, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment of software and services.
Candidates should possess skills in Cybersecurity, including risk assessment, threat analysis, security controls selection, and governance alignment.
Candidates should possess skills in Network Security, covering secure network design, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention.
Candidates should possess skills in Information Security, including data protection strategies, identity and access management, and compliance with relevant regulations.
Relevant experience in architect-level security roles, preferably within system integration, IT services, or complex enterprise environments.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degrees or recognized security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, CCSP) are beneficial.
Ability to communicate complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to influence strategic decisions.
Experience working in or with organizations in the Middle East region and familiarity with regional regulatory and compliance requirements is an advantage.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
💼 Senior Manager – AI Solution Architect

📌 Abu Dhabi
(relocation benefits can be provided)

As the Senior Manager and AI Solution Architect, you will hold one of the most influential technical positions within one of Abu Dhabi’s leading financial institutions. Working within the AI Innovation Hub
you will bridge the gap between visionary "AI Lab" experimentation and enterprise-grade deployment. You’ll be hands on and leading a team to revolutionise customer experience through agentic workflows, RAG, and large-scale automation across 100+ real-world use cases.

What you’ll be doing:

Architecting the Future:
Lead the design and deployment of customer-facing AI systems, specifically focusing on Agentic Workflow Automation and Enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
Hands-on Leadership:
You aren't just drawing boxes on a whiteboard. You will manage a high-performing team, building POCs and scaling them into production-ready solutions.
Infrastructure Excellence:
Build the frameworks and toolsets that our AI engineers use to thrive.
Influence & Governance:
Navigate architecture approvals and represent your technical vision to senior stakeholders, ensuring our AI capabilities are both cutting-edge and compliant.
The AI Lab:
Constantly scout and test "the next big thing" in tech to see how it can be weaponised for the bank’s competitive advantage.

What we’re looking for:

An Architect who has evolved. You likely started in traditional Enterprise Architecture but have spent the last 3–4 years deep in the trenches of AI implementation.

Azure Power User:
You are exceptionally strong in Azure
(this is a must). If you know your way around AWS, that’s a fantastic bonus.
AI Specialist:
You have a proven track record of building and scaling AI applications (RAG, Chatbots, Agentic systems).
The "Agile" Architect:
You move fast. You can build architecture frameworks quickly without getting bogged down in "analysis paralysis."
The Communicator:
You are confident, persuasive, and able to translate complex AI logic into business value for executive-level stakeholders.
Experienced:
You have at least 7 years of professional experience
, specifically delivering products within complex, high-stakes environments (Banking/Fintech/Enterprise).
